origin: User-supplied ICT/SMC description: downtrend -> sweep of sell-side liquidity into a demand OB -> MSS with displacement/FVG -> retest entry -> target buy-side liquidity, minimum RR 1:3. Mirrored for shorts.
pre_result_feasibility_disclosure: Before freezing, the detector was run on the warmup period only (2024-08-01..2025-05-01, outside every evaluation window), reading geometry counts and gross RR only, never PnL. 245 MSS-confirmed setups on 6 symbols; only 2 had the NEAREST 1h BSL at >= 3R, 190 had some 1h BSL at 3-10R. Therefore two routes are frozen.

routes.STRICT: target = nearest confirmed 1h swing high above the MSS close; trade only if its stress net R >= 3 (literal user rule; expected to be sparse)
routes.EXTERNAL: target = nearest confirmed 1h swing high above the MSS close whose stress net R is in [3, 10] (user's 'TP2 - next BSL' read as the first external liquidity worth 3R)

multiple_testing: Two routes are tested; a route passing only by chance is plausible. Each route must pass every gate on its own.

data.source: Binance public USD-M checksumed 1m kline and funding archives

setup_long.context: last two confirmed 1h swing highs descending AND last two confirmed 1h swing lows descending (swing width 2), known at the previous closed 15m bar
setup_long.zone: 1h bullish OB = last bearish 1h candle among the 3 bars before a 1h candle with body >= 1.0 ATR14(1h) and close in top 30% of range; zone [OB low, OB open]; published at the displacement close; dead after a 1h close below the zone or after 240h; one setup per zone
setup_long.sweep: closed 15m low below the latest confirmed 15m swing low (pivot within the last 96 bars) by >= 0.05 ATR14(15m), with the low inside [zone bottom - 0.5 ATR, zone top]; a confirmed 15m swing high (LH) must exist above the sweep close
setup_long.mss: within 16 closed 15m bars a close >= LH + 0.05 ATR; abort if a close falls below zone bottom - 0.5 ATR
setup_long.fvg: latest bullish 3-bar FVG (low[i] - high[i-2] >= 0.10 ATR) inside the sweep..MSS leg; none -> no trade

execution.entry: maker limit at the FVG proximal edge, placed at the MSS bar close, valid 240 minutes; 1 open position and 1 pending order globally
execution.stop: sweep extreme (lowest low sweep..MSS) - 0.10 ATR; stop width must be 0.35-3.0 ATR(15m)
execution.target: single target per route; no partials, no breakeven, no trailing
execution.same_bar: stop checked before target; no target on the limit fill bar

gates_on_stress.sequence: a window is only replayed after the previous window's gate passed; a failed gate is terminal, no tuning

after_historical_pass: Compare against corrected BENCH_AB_R2 on identical windows, then shadow paper-forward only. No live approval from this study.
